sm_top.sm: British counterterrorism police made explosives arrests near RAF Fairford, an air base used for American strikes on Iran.
The Saudi-led coalition intercepted three Houthi ballistic missiles heading towards Riyadh and Khamis Mushait.
UAE officials stated that a Flydubai co-pilot planned a suicide attack on an Israel-bound flight and acted alone.
Houthi and Yemeni government forces are engaged in heavy combat for control of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait and surrounding areas in Taiz.
Reports state Iran launched missiles and drones at ships in the Strait of Hormuz.
The coalition reported that three ballistic missiles launched by the Houthi militia toward Riyadh and Khamis Mushait were intercepted and destroyed.
A Hamas field commander was killed in an Israeli UAV strike near Shifa Hospital in Gaza City.
Ukraine's Air Force reported that Russian strikes killed at least 10 people and injured 45 across Ukraine, following an overnight attack using 142 Shahed-type drones.
Airstrikes and explosions were reported in the Yemeni capital of Sanaa.
Rybar claims Russian forces launched a massive overnight missile and drone strike targeting military-industrial and energy infrastructure across multiple Ukrainian regions.
A drone strike on the Sheraro IDP camp in Tigray killed eight people.
The U.S. is deploying a third aircraft carrier strike group to the Middle East amid rising tensions with Iran.
Russia launched over 200 missiles at Ukraine, including North Korean KN-23 ballistic missiles.
President Zelensky reports that Russia launched 1,900 drones and 25 missiles over the past week.
Houthi forces launched missile and drone attacks targeting Aden airport.
Hamas stated that Al-Amoudi, a possible successor to Sinwar, survived an Israeli strike in Gaza.
A US military strike on a drug-smuggling boat in the Caribbean left four people dead.
Yemeni government forces launched a strategic offensive operation aimed at recapturing Sanaa from Houthi rebels.
TPLF fighters withdrew from Mekelle as Ethiopian federal and allied forces took control of the city and airport.
Russian Ministry of Defence claims air defense systems intercepted and destroyed 399 Ukrainian drones overnight across multiple regions and the Black Sea.
The aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln returned to San Diego after supporting operations related to the Iran conflict.
Houthis report that Saudi forces launched 94 air strikes across Yemen over a 24-hour period.
Houthi-aligned media claim a cruise missile targeted a ship near the coast of Qatar, causing a fire.
A missile was launched toward the Strait of Hormuz.
Ukrainian strikes hit the Redkino cruise-missile fuel plant in Tver Oblast, a Yandex data center in Kaluga, and a Belgorod oil depot.
Iranian media reported that a 2.5 million-barrel oil tanker was struck in the Strait of Hormuz.
Ukraine debuted and deployed its new FP-7 ballistic missile in combat for the first time.
Malian forces and Russian allies retook control of the strategic northern stronghold of Kidal.
Iran states it targeted a gas tanker in the Strait of Hormuz.
Saudi Arabia claims intercepting a Houthi drone near Mecca, which the Houthis deny.
The IRGC claimed a strike on the Vietnamese LPG tanker NV Sunshine.
Two oil tankers are struck by projectiles near the Strait of Hormuz.
Government forces reportedly take control of the Bab el-Mandeb strait while airstrikes hit Sanaa and heavy fighting continues.
The Ukrainian Air Force reported guided aerial bomb strikes targeting Kharkiv and Sumy oblasts.
The Saudi-led coalition reported shooting down a Houthi missile.
An RSF drone strike in Sudan reportedly killed 26 women and 4 children.
A Fox News expert stated that a Russian Geran-4 drone was likely used in a recent ship attack in the Black Sea.
Houthi forces launch missiles from Yemen toward Saudi positions and militia concentrations.
Ethiopia and Eritrea accused one another of launching an unprovoked war and border incursions into Tigray.
Russian drone and missile attack: strikes reported in 4 places, including Ukraine, Kramatorsk and Kyiv.
